body: Paf adopted ChatGPT Enterprise across its entire company, with engineers using custom GPTs on a daily basis to speed up routine development tasks. Paf also integrated ChatGPT Enterprise into the grit:lab coding academy (gritlab.ax), training the next generation of software developers using an AI-augmented, systems-architecture mindset from day one. In addition to the wide range of use cases for developers and grit:lab students, 70% of Paf employees actively use ChatGPT Enterprise, spanning business teams like finance, HR, marketing, and customer support.
summaryZh: 通过自定义 GPT 提高开发人员的工作效率。Paf 在整个公司范围内采用了 ChatGPT Enterprise，工程师每天都使用自定义 GPT 来加快日常开发任务的速度。 Paf 还将 ChatGPT Enterprise 集成到 grit:lab 编码学院 (gritlab.ax) 中，从第一天起就使用人工智能增强的系统架构思维方式培训下一代软件开发人员。
